dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Welcome to Qingce Village, Traveler. You'll have to forgive us if it's not all too lively around there.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Our village is comprised largely of the very old and the very young, and since those meteorites came down, some of us have fallen asleep, unable to awaken. We can only hope that this blows over soon...
